construction_notes.text: Mixed-use: also up to 3 million sq ft office/R&D and up to 100,000 sq ft retail per city items. Product type is a working label from "multi-family residential units".

City staff report (Nov. 19, 2024): up to 1.8 million sq ft of residential, 3 million sq ft office/R&D (2.2 million under Option B), about 100,000 sq ft retail and 10,000 sq ft childcare; housing in Area D under Option A and also Area C under Option B. Development agreement: 10-year term with up to three 5-year extensions; at least 1.5 acres of parkland, plus 1.5 acres in Area C under Option B; 1 parking space per unit in Areas C and D. Site is currently used for Levi's Stadium event parking (3,300 spaces); a prior owner demolished buildings for a planned Yahoo! campus.

San Jose Spotlight: Council approved unanimously on Nov. 19, 2024; Kylli has owned the property since 2017; tallest building limited to 192 feet; more than seven acres of parks; construction to be phased starting with housing.
SF YIMBY, Nov. 2024: four podium structures; construction expected in four phases over at least a decade.

CEQAnet SCH 2018072068: NOPs July 27 and Oct. 1, 2018 (3005 Democracy Way Mixed-Use) and April 18, 2022; Draft EIR Nov. 16, 2023; Final EIR Nov. 26, 2024; NODs Nov. 22 and Dec. 13, 2024. Project description: up to about 2,600 units and up to 4,915,000 gsf.
